create_MiniImageNet_dataset: create a MiniImageNet dataset from a pickle file at a given root directory for training or testing
create_iMiniImageNet_dataset: create an incremental MiniImageNet dataset with class filtering, memory replay, and task labels for continual learning
create_DatasetGen: create a DatasetGen object that manages task splits, dataloaders, and memory for incremental MiniImageNet continual learning
run_DatasetGen_get: run the get method on DatasetGen to generate train, validation, test, and t-SNE dataloaders for a given task ID
run_DatasetGen_update_memory: run the update_memory method on DatasetGen to sample and store replay images for a specified task
